notes.title: [NEWS] Release Date Reconfirmed!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728753/a49c67f4b59e097dfb24b71b6e28deb1fa2ae89d.png

Hi everyone!

I hope you're all doing well! I have some exciting news to share with you today. The release date for "Love in Login" has been reconfirmed, and this time, it's for real! 🌟

Mark your calendars for August 26th at 23:00 GMT+0, because that's when you’ll finally be able to dive into the game. I’ve been pushing the team really hard because I know how much you've been waiting, and we absolutely cannot keep you waiting any longer.

Thank you so much to everyone who has been patiently waiting for this moment.
Your support has meant the world to us, and I’m so grateful that we can finally meet in-game next week!


With love, your sweetheart, Da-hye 💌

notes.title: [NEWS] Release Date Delayed
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728753/f1db6ed3f915cbe75e338c09f58d776761cc5005.png

Hi everyone

I hope you're all doing well! I have some news to share, and I want to be upfront with you.
I'm so sorry to tell you this, but the release date for "Love in Login" has been delayed 😔

I really wanted to make it on time, but there are just a few more things left to take care of to make sure the game is absolutely perfect for you all! I promise we are working hard, and it won’t be long before you can dive into the game.

I can't pinpoint the exact release date right now, but I really want to see you all in the game soon.
Your support means everything to me, and I appreciate your patience more than words can say.

Thank you so much for understanding, and I’ll keep you updated!

Sending lots of love,
Dahye

notes.title: [NEWS] Love in Login Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It's been a while, and I know you've been eagerly waiting for updates. Today, I bring you some exciting news!

I am thrilled to announce the official release date of "Love in Login"! 🎉 The game will be available on August 12th, 23:00 GMT+0.

Thank you to all of you who have patiently waited and supported us. I can't wait to see you in the game!

With love,
Dahye
